source: Planet & Narrative's SS2 archetype palette, locked 23 Oct 2026 on ticket 775 (spec #774, GD lock on Campaign Scaling 23 Oct 20:20): name parts in the ledger voice keyed to the act colour, the eight biome looks (hue and ground motif, each pair distinct), and Progression's SS2-B new-content set (23 Oct on #775; ticket 780 writes each family's behaviour with its Never column, its copy templates and its rig part). Progression's fifth row, the 'Void glass' ore family, is refused by the fail-on-recolour check (the first system's exotic family, Hollow's signature from planet 33, is already Voidglass); ticket 780 names its replacement, spall glass, which keeps the behaviour (a side cut shatters it) under a name no earlier content carries. Written once; every system from the second draws from it by seed and nothing is authored per planet. Prefixes are keyed to the #141 act at the planet's campaign index; the Foothold+ prefixes serve the foothold.heavy act, since no system past the first ever holds planet 1's act.

behaviour.summary: Timed gas jets from vents you can see before they fire; a rig caught in the jet has its drill stalled while it burns, hull and energy untouched. The telegraph lasts at least the reaction window (#676).

copy.arrivalLine: Vent flares. The vents breathe before they burn; wait the beat.
hoverLines: The vents of {planet} breathe before they fire.
A jet stalls the drill, nothing more.

behaviour.summary: Cargo of this family loses value every minute until it is sold, so a quick trip home beats a full hold.

copy.arrivalLine: Cinder salts. They fade in the hold by the minute; sell quick.
hoverLines: Loses value every minute until sold.
On {planet} a quick trip home beats a full hold.

behaviour.summary: Latch onto the hull and drain cargo value over time until you drill or ram them off; no tool is disabled and nothing is shot.

copy.arrivalLine: Brine leech. They cling and sup the hold; drill or ram them off.
hoverLines: Latch on and drain cargo value over time.
Below {planet}, drill or ram them off.

behaviour.summary: Loose sand flows down into the shaft and clogs the drill, cutting its speed until cleared; nothing pulls the rig and the compass holds true.

copy.arrivalLine: Sand sinks. Loose sand runs into the cut; clear it or crawl.
hoverLines: Sand flows into the shaft and clogs the drill.
On {planet} it cuts drill speed until cleared.

behaviour.summary: Drilling it from the side shatters it and its value is lost; only a cut straight down keeps it whole.

copy.arrivalLine: Spall glass. A side cut spalls it to dust; bore straight down.
hoverLines: Shatters when cut from the side.
A straight-down cut keeps it whole on {planet}.
